stem.text: A rubber cord hangs from a rigid support. A weight attached to its lower end is gradually increased from zero, and then gradually reduced to zero.

stem.alt: Diagram of a rubber cord hanging from a rigid support, with a weight attached to its lower end. Printed labels: rubber cord, weight.

Force against extension graph with axes labelled force (vertical) and extension (horizontal), with 0 at the origin. Two curves start at the origin and are joined into a shaded region between them, with arrows on the curves. Printed labels: stretching, contraction.

stem.text: The force–extension curve for contraction is below the force–extension curve for stretching.
What does the shaded area between the curves represent?

A.text: the elastic potential energy stored in the rubber cord

B.text: the thermal energy dissipated in the rubber cord

C.text: the work done by the rubber cord during contraction

D.text: the work done on the rubber cord during stretching
